pasteHtmlHint: Already have a page built elsewhere? Paste the complete HTML here — no credits used. You can still refine it with AI afterwards.
pdfGroundingHint: Grounding in a PDF adds a per-page conversion charge on top of the generation cost.
keyPointsPlaceholder: Optional key points to cover — one per line
promptPlaceholderEdit: Describe a change — e.g. "make the quiz harder and add a drag-drop game"
promptPlaceholderCreate: Describe the page — e.g. "an interactive lesson on photosynthesis"
authoredByAiHint: Authored by AI so the page can be freely creative — animations, interactive quizzes and games all run. Diagrams and textbook illustrations are drawn in (each generated picture costs 2 extra credits). ⌘/Ctrl + Enter to generate.
reportsResultsHint: ✓ Reports results to the gradebook — you scored {{result}} in this preview.
generatingHint: The AI is designing a rich, self-contained page from your materials. This usually takes 2–4 minutes — you can leave and come back.
addMaterialsHint: Add materials and describe what you want, then generate — or paste HTML you already have.

toast.describeRequired: Describe the page, pick sections, add key points, or attach a PDF.
toast.notHtml: That does not look like HTML — paste the full page markup.
toast.htmlAdded: HTML added. Refine it with AI or edit the source anytime.
toast.finishedWhileAway: Your page finished generating while you were away.
toast.generationInterrupted: Generation was interrupted (server restarted). Please try again — you were not charged.
toast.lostConnection: Lost connection while checking progress. Reopen this slide to pick the page up when it's ready.

previewAppearsHere: The live preview appears here as soon as the page starts being written.

progress.canLeaveHint: Usually takes 2–4 minutes. You can switch slides or close this tab — the page keeps building and will be here when you come back.
progress.stayHint: Usually takes 2–4 minutes. Keep this tab open until it finishes.
